what_changed: Implemented Phase 1 minimum execution loop API path in gateway_fastapi: session/start, focus/start, focus/end, reflect, today.
Added manual flow endpoints for journal entry/promote and core promote while keeping /v1/narrative and /v1/ocr/ingest compatibility.
Changed OCR ingest to non-blocking behavior by persisting image event acceptance first and running OCR/AI refinement in background.
After Phase 1 test pass evidence, added Phase 2 minimum ai_jobs lifecycle and non-blocking insight fallback endpoints.

risks.description: Demo-scope in-memory runtime is not durable across process restart and may diverge from future DB schema adoption.

next_3_actions: Aggregate this backend evidence with frontend/android lane artifacts for Phase 1/2 CT verdict.
If approved, add DB-backed persistence behind feature flags in a separate migration-approved phase.
Expand integration tests to include cross-lane end-to-end execution session flow.
